rationale: Rules need version/effectivity/provenance and independent administration
Ordered governed rule composition needs independent identity/version and execution reference
Membership/order/applicability belongs to relationship between rule set and rule
Evaluation must bind exact subject/context/rule-set version and retain reproducible evidence
Per-rule result belongs to one evaluation run
Material conflict can require correction waiver disposition and closure evidence
Valid relationship rules require governed scope/effectivity and independent policy history
Reusable semantic/default mapping policy requires versioned scope and precedence
Session/meeting has participants schedule status subject links and retained record
Thread needs independent subject state participants and history
Contribution/comment has authorship draft/published state timestamp and attachments
Subscription is user/team interest state and must remain independent from permission
Collection has owner/context and membership history without owning referenced objects
Cross-context reference needs type provenance/effectivity without altering context hierarchy
Versioned governed type identity needs inheritance object-family compatibility and independent administration
Reusable attribute semantics must be versioned independently from any one domain type
Requiredness cardinality order local label and default belong to the governed relationship between type and attribute
Reusable constraints require versioned configuration and independent assignment provenance
Constraint ordering and mandatory/advisory mode belong to the attribute-assignment relationship
Controlled value sets require governed identity version and effectivity independent from consuming attributes
Enumeration values are controlled children with stable code label order external mapping and status
Named versioned selection logic needs independent identity effectivity administration and reproducible execution reference
Ordered criterion type configuration and mandatory/advisory behaviour belong to one resolution definition
A run binds exact definition context inputs evaluation instant and terminal resolution outcome
Per-item selected version criterion conflict/unresolved state and source evidence belong to one resolution run
